methodology: One multiplicative factor per production scale (Small / Medium / Large, from the predicted shoot days with the service's 60- and 150-day thresholds). Each factor is the weighted median of actual/estimate ratios, which minimises percentage error. The method was chosen by 5-fold CV on the 160 training films, fitted on all 160 and scored once on the same 40 held-out films as the shoot-day holdout. The baseline is the mean reported budget of the training films in the same reported tier.
limitations: The factors correct the film-level benchmark costing. The scene-level engine behind the Budget Engine page is not calibrated, because it has not been scored against reported budgets.
The baseline is given the reported budget tier, which the live system does not know, so the comparison is generous to the baseline.
Error stays near 50%: films with similar entity counts and schedules have very different reported budgets, mostly because of star fees, which no script-derived count captures.
